shared_rule: Preserve the approved pose-class base identity, attire or draping, anatomy, pose, camera, crop, lighting and background; change only the requested facial state unless the anesthetized lithotomy slot explicitly requires its mask and breathing circuit.

expressions.ward/afraid: wide anxious eyes, raised inner brows and slightly parted tense mouth
expressions.ward/crying: quiet tears with a trembling mouth
expressions.intraoperative/pain: eyes partly squeezed shut in acute controlled pain with one sweat bead
expressions.intraoperative/near_collapse: awake but pale, exhausted and nearly collapsing
expressions.intraoperative/anesthetized: eyes fully closed and peaceful; no mask, tube, sterile drape or other fabric in portrait slot
expressions.operating_table/afraid: clearly afraid, serious rather than comedic
expressions.operating_table/anesthetized: eyes fully closed and relaxed; no mask in this slot
expressions.operating_table_lithotomy/afraid: clearly afraid, serious rather than comedic
expressions.operating_table_lithotomy/anesthetized: eyes peacefully closed with a transparent anesthesia mask and one continuous corrugated tube connected to the right-side anesthesia machine
